title: Kourovka Notebook Problem 21.68
exact_target: Are all finite groups constructed through the source’s abelian semidirect-product quotient process monomial?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2577 (KOU-21.68). CC BY 4.0.
